title: AgentDefinition
description: Schema for z-harness agent definition files.

name.description: Unique identifier name for this agent.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this agent does.

model.description: Optional native model fallback label from frontmatter. May be a built-in tier (haiku, sonnet, opus) or an exact host model label; model_routing.native_agents can override it by agent id.

developer_instructions.description: Required source body or native-agent instruction text associated with this agent.

model_class.description: Optional model class route name. When present, native dispatch may resolve it through model_classes.<class>.model before falling back to model.

thinking.description: Optional host-specific thinking metadata for this agent's frontmatter fallback.

reasoning.description: Optional host-specific reasoning metadata for this agent's frontmatter fallback.

tools.description: Optional list of tool names available to this agent.

triggers.description: Optional list of trigger identifiers that activate this agent.
